slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, or is there a different objective such as maximizing the number of tables within a budget?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and confirmed minimizing total cost.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked only about general per-supplier order limits and whether the total-table constraint was the only constraint; it never asked about the conditional rule that ordering from A requires at least 30 tables from B.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C, nor did it explicitly mark this conditional rule as needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier A and Supplier B are independent, so ordering from A imposes no requirement to order at least 30 tables from B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional requirement and then omitted it from the final model constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier B and Supplier C are independent, so ordering from B does not require also ordering from C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional requirement and then omitted it from the final model constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 conditional business-rule slots remained unasked and unconfirmed.

summary: The agent correctly confirmed the objective and basic order quantities, but stopped prematurely without investigating the key conditional supplier constraints, leading to a model that silently treats Suppliers A, B, and C as independent.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
